## Confirmed non-deterministic: same commit, red then green

The re-run I spent on PR #7577 came back **success**. Both runs are on head `681053908`, byte-identical:

| run | `Test (shard 2/4)` | window |
|:--|:--|:--|
| first | **failure** — `expected […] to have a length of 2 but got 5` | 00:02:00 → 00:15:12 |
| re-run | **success** | 00:18:02 → 00:28:49 |

That upgrades the diagnosis from "the assertion reads an unsettled chain, therefore it *can* race" to a measurement: **it does**, on unchanged content. Which is exactly the shape #7075 quoted from #6959 — *"one PR failing and passing on byte-identical content"* — and the reason a red here ejects unrelated PRs from the merge queue rather than reporting a defect.

⚠️ Worth stating what this does **not** prove: it does not tell you how often. One red in two runs is not a rate, and ⛔ nobody should treat the green as evidence the site is fine. The structural reading in the card is the finding; this pair just removes "maybe it was a real regression" from the table.

Serial constraints cleared: **none contended.** Measured at claim time against every open PR's file list: no open PR touches `packages/plugin-detail/`. ⚠️ Re-measure at implementation time; ⛔ do not inherit this line — three PRs landed under a sibling card within one hour today.

## Why this is p1 and not a nit

The card is not a census finding, it is a **live CI red** on PR #7577 head `681053908`, and comment [5533924556](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/7579#issuecomment-5533924556) upgraded it from "can race" to "does race": the same head ran **failure then success**, byte-identical content. Per #7075 quoting #6959, a red here **ejects unrelated PRs from the merge queue** — #6959 measured two ejections in fifteen minutes.

⚠️ And per that same comment, stated so it is not overread: one red in two runs is **not a rate**, and ⛔ the green is not evidence the site is fine. The structural reading in the card body is the finding.

## Correction to my claim above — the serial-constraint line was written wrong

My claim comment [5552324826](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/7579#issuecomment-5552324826) says:

> no open PR touches `packages/plugin-detail/`

**That sentence is false**, and my own measurement in the same breath said so. The correct reading:

| PR | file under `packages/plugin-detail/` |
| :-- | :-- |
| **#7058** (`dependabot/npm_and_yarn/lucide-react-1.35.0`) | `packages/plugin-detail/package.json` |
| every other open PR | none |

**The conclusion does not change** — a dependency-range bump in `package.json` cannot contend with a gate inside `RelatedList.serverpagination.test.tsx`, so the file surface claimed is still uncontended, and the dispatch stands. What changed is the *statement*: "nothing touches the directory" and "nothing touches my files" are different claims, and I shipped the stronger one on evidence for the weaker.

Correcting it because a serial-constraint line is a measurement, and a measurement that is convenient and false is the exact thing this seat has been correcting on other people's records today. ⚠️ The dispatch brief carries the corrected form, and the re-measure-at-implementation-time instruction is unchanged: ⛔ the dev does not inherit either version of this line.
